prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead summary` says the heading is N for my ridge walk, which runs due east from 42.20, 23.30 to 42.20, 23.45." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git status --short && git ls-files && grep -rn -i "heading\|trailhead" --include=*.py . | head -80
cat src/trailhead/report.py && cat src/trailhead/geo.py && cat tests/test_geo.py && sed -n 1,30p tests/test_report.py

PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from trailhead.geo import initial_bearing as b, compass_point as c
for name,args in [('east',(42.20,23.30,42.20,23.45)),('north',(42.20,23.30,42.35,23.30)),('south',(42.35,23.30,42.20,23.30)),('west',(42.20,23.45,42.20,23.30))]:
    v=b(*args); print(name, round(v,3), c(v))
" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

cat >> tests/test_geo.py <<'EOF'


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("end", "expected"),
    [((42.35, 23.30), 0), ((42.20, 23.45), 90), ((42.05, 23.30), 180), ((42.20, 23.15), 270)],
)
def test_initial_bearing_of_cardinal_directions(end, expected):
    bearing = initial_bearing(42.20, 23.30, *end)
    assert min(abs(bearing - expected), 360 - abs(bearing - expected)) < 0.5


def test_ridge_running_due_east_is_east(make_track):
    from trailhead.report import summarise

    track = make_track((42.20, 23.30, 1000), (42.20, 23.45, 1000), name="Ridge")
    assert summarise(track).heading == "E"
EOF
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from trailhead.geo import initial_bearing as b, compass_point as c
for a in [(42.20,23.30,42.20,23.45),(42.20,23.30,42.35,23.30),(42.35,23.30,42.20,23.30),(42.20,23.45,42.20,23.30)]: print(c(b(*a)))"
